articles.title: Nkunku fires Milan top of Serie A, Hojlund keeps Napoli in touch
articles.mainIdea: Nkunku fires Milan top of Serie A, Hojlund keeps Napoli in touch
articles.summary: AFP: Nkunku fires Milan top of Serie A, Hojlund keeps Napoli in touch. Christopher Nkunku fired AC Milan top of Serie A with a brace in Sunday's 3-0 win over Verona at the San Siro, the France forward's first goals in Italy's top flight.Sunday's brace was his second for Napoli after he also scored both goals in their win earlier this month over fierce rivals Juventus who drop down to fourth, three points behind Milan.
